summary: VeriGate AI-SDLC v3.1.1 fails closed in ci-check when --base cannot be resolved or when base-branch config/policy JSON is malformed (allowing working_tree_fallback only on first-adoption PRs where --base resolves with no config), removes `|| true` from CI `git fetch` commands, and rejects gated_paths rules with empty verify lists unless explicitly opted in with allow_empty_verify: true.
